definitions.explanation: A state of below-normal performance, activity, or results. Used for business conditions, athletic performance, or general decline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{不振|ふしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{打撃|だげき}→打撃：12775_dageki⟧{不振|ふしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧{不振|ふしん}で{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Sales dropped due to the economic slump.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{不|ふ} (not, un-) + {振|しん} (flourishing, prosperity)

USAGE:
Commonly used in:
- Business/economics: {業績|ぎょうせき}{不振|ふしん}, ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧{不振|ふしん}
- Sports: ⟦{打撃|だげき}→打撃：12775_dageki⟧{不振|ふしん}, ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧{不振|ふしん}
- Health: ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧{不振|ふしん} (loss of appetite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不振|ふしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ - to fall into a slump
- {不振|ふしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|だっ}する→脱する：28650_dassuru⟧ - to escape from a slump
- {不振|ふしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ - the slump continues
